trustBoundaries.name: Người dùng/Renderer sang Main/Supervisor
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: contextIsolation, sandboxed renderer, schema IPC, sender validation and capability allowlist

trustBoundaries.name: Main/Supervisor sang Gateway
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Loopback, dynamic endpoint, scoped client identity, Supervisor-owned credential and protocol validation

trustBoundaries.name: Máy khách sang Internet/provider
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Deny-by-default egress, allowlisted destination, TLS, explicit provider and visible data egress

trustBoundaries.name: Runtime sang host/workspace
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Sandbox backend, least privilege, canonical path policy, quarantine and approval

trustBoundaries.name: Agent Home sang Không gian dự án
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Separate paths and source-of-truth, explicit none/read-only/read-write grant, no link escape

trustBoundaries.name: Worker sang Advisor
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Minimal review package, output-as-data marking, read-only permissions and schema-validated verdict

trustBoundaries.name: Core sang extension/channel
trustBoundaries.from: OpenClaw and AI for Boss core
trustBoundaries.to: Plugin, skill, MCP, channel and hook
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Provenance, hash, permission diff, allowlist, quarantine and revoke

trustBoundaries.name: Desktop sang Always-on
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Private ingress, expiring one-time claim, device identity, least scope and per-customer instance

trustBoundaries.name: Live state sang backup/update/support artifact
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Encryption, signature, redaction, verification, staging and user-initiated export

trustBoundaries.name: OS account sang principal khác
trustBoundaries.from: AI for Boss profile and IPC endpoints
trustBoundaries.to: Other local users, services or devices
trustBoundaries.defaultControl: Per-user ACL, protected IPC, separate OS user/host for real trust separation and full-disk encryption recommendation

threats.title: Artifact, dependency hoặc update bị cấy/sửa
abuseCases: Updater nhận artifact downgrade hoặc sai kiến trúc
threats.failClosedBehavior: Reject artifact and keep the previous verified bundle.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 0.5 policy, Gate 4 signed-artifact tamper and rollback tests

residualRisk.reason: No signing identities or production updater exist.

threats.title: Gateway, Supervisor hoặc remote instance giả mạo
abuseCases: Client nối nhầm Gateway của app khác
Remote endpoint giả nhận credential hoặc command
requiredControls: Build ID and release train checks
threats.failClosedBehavior: Do not adopt, kill or connect to the unknown process; enter diagnostic state.
threats.evidenceGate: Gate 1 foreign-process tests and Gate 4 remote identity tests

residualRisk.reason: The ownership and identity contracts are specified but not implemented.

threats.title: Static secret, OAuth token hoặc backup secret bị lộ
abuseCases: Secret lọt renderer, argv, log hoặc crash dump
Support bundle hoặc backup mang token không được mã hóa
requiredControls: OS key store via tested SecretRef for static secret
OpenClaw native auth store with per-user ACL for OAuth
threats.failClosedBehavior: Disable connector, revoke credential when exposure is suspected and produce a secret-free incident record.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 0.5 secret baseline, three-OS SecretRef contract, support-bundle and restore tests

residualRisk.reason: Credential Broker and redaction pipeline are not implemented.

threats.title: OAuth state/callback bị dùng lại, tráo hoặc hết phiên
requiredControls: Runtime commit plus live probe before success
threats.failClosedBehavior: Discard temporary auth state and require a fresh sign-in; never accept pasted partial query strings.

residualRisk.reason: End-to-end product OAuth has not been implemented or tested.

threats.title: One-time claim, pairing hoặc scope upgrade bị chiếm
abuseCases: Device bị chiếm vẫn còn quyền
threats.failClosedBehavior: Reject claim or scope upgrade and preserve the narrower current permission only.
threats.evidenceGate: Gate 4 claim reuse, wrong-instance, scope-upgrade and revoke tests

residualRisk.reason: Remote claim and pairing product flows do not exist.

threats.title: Prompt injection từ web, file, channel hoặc agent khác
abuseCases: Tài liệu yêu cầu đọc secret
Tool output giả instruction hệ thống
Agent con chèn lệnh vào Advisor
Channel message dụ mở rộng quyền
requiredControls: Treat all external and delegated output as data
threats.failClosedBehavior: Block requested effect, quarantine suspicious memory/content and keep the task unverified.

residualRisk.reason: Agentic security controls and sandbox are not implemented.

threats.title: Advisor bị thao túng hoặc biến lỗi thành pass
abuseCases: Worker output chứa instruction cho Advisor
Parse lỗi được coi là đạt
threats.failClosedBehavior: Set review status to unreviewed or blocked and require explicit user action.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 2.6 plan/final benchmark and Gate 3 adversarial Advisor test

residualRisk.reason: Advisor orchestration and benchmark are not implemented.

threats.title: Renderer, IPC, process hoặc local principal vượt quyền
abuseCases: Socket/pipe cho user khác truy cập
threats.failClosedBehavior: Reject IPC or connection and stop privileged action without exposing a reusable credential.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 0.4/0.5 Electron security tests and Gate 1 local process attack tests

residualRisk.reason: Desktop shell and IPC baseline are not built.

threats.title: Model tự cấp quyền, tự duyệt hoặc gây hành động quá mức
abuseCases: Lặp tool hoặc sub-agent không giới hạn
threats.failClosedBehavior: Deny the effect, pause the task and ask the user with an auditable decision.

residualRisk.reason: Policy compiler, approval inbox and sandbox do not exist.

threats.title: Path traversal, symlink escape hoặc file giả mạo
abuseCases: File thực thi đổi đuôi thành ảnh
threats.failClosedBehavior: Reject read/write/execute, quarantine the file and leave the destination unchanged.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 0.6 and Gate 3 file/sandbox adversarial suite on each OS

residualRisk.reason: Cross-platform sandbox and file policy are unproven.

threats.title: Bootstrap, migration hoặc restore tạo trạng thái nửa vời
threats.failClosedBehavior: Keep old state active, preserve BOOTSTRAP.md and resume from the last verified checkpoint.
threats.evidenceGate: Feature 2.2/2.5 crash matrix and Gate 4 restore drill

residualRisk.reason: The state machine is locked but no writer or restore implementation exists.

threats.title: Plugin, MCP, channel hoặc network connector vượt contract
abuseCases: Connector gửi dữ liệu tới domain lạ
Channel gửi nhầm nơi hoặc dùng delegated authority quá rộng
threats.failClosedBehavior: Disable or disconnect the extension and preserve a redacted incident/audit event.
threats.evidenceGate: Gate 3 extension, SSRF, wrong-destination and drift suite

residualRisk.reason: Provenance catalog and network policy are not implemented.

threats.title: Replay, vòng lặp hoặc concurrency gây chi phí và mutation trùng
threats.failClosedBehavior: Pause uncertain work and require reconciliation before a new mutation is accepted.
threats.evidenceGate: Gate 1 reconnect/idempotency and Gate 3 denial-of-wallet tests

residualRisk.reason: Budget enforcement and replay reconciliation are not implemented.

threats.title: Cross-tenant hoặc shared trust boundary làm lộ dữ liệu khách
abuseCases: Session ID bị coi là tenant boundary
Support/operator đọc nội dung khách ngoài policy
requiredControls: One full instance per customer or true trust boundary
Separate OS user/host, state, credential and volume
threats.failClosedBehavior: Deny provisioning or connection when isolation cannot be proven; do not fall back to shared runtime.
threats.evidenceGate: Headless Gate 4 cross-tenant suite and Gate 7 tenant-isolation review

residualRisk.reason: Per-customer architecture is chosen but no headless product exists.

outOfScope: Administrator or root already controlling the device
Malware running with the same or higher OS privilege than AI for Boss
An unlocked stolen device without effective OS disk encryption or account lock
Compromised firmware, operating system kernel or hardware security boundary
Provider account compromise that occurs outside AI for Boss
A user intentionally approving a clearly described dangerous action after all controls and warnings

reviewGate.evidenceRule: A Critical or High threat cannot be closed by prose; it requires implemented control plus adversarial or recovery evidence at its named gate.
